properties.statement:
MEASURED on reflow2's own design (2487 nodes, 9975 edges, 83 gaps) by driving the BUILT binary against a temp store imported from docs/design/reflow2.json, scoping detect_gaps to each of the 56 Components in turn.

AT THE DEFAULT DEPTH OF 3, SCOPE DOES NOT NARROW. Every one of the 56 Components returns between 50 and 60 of the design's 83 gaps — median 55, i.e. two thirds of every gap in the design, whichever component you pick. region_size runs 595-903 nodes (24-36% of the design). The spread across all 56 is 50..60: the answers are indistinguishable, so a team reading `in_scope: 55, out_of_scope: 28` is being told 'your part has 55 gaps' when every other team is told the same thing about theirs.

SHALLOWER DEPTHS DISCRIMINATE, SHARPLY:
  depth 1: region_size 17..139 (median 28), in_scope 0..19 (median 1)
  depth 2: region_size 267..601 (median 330), in_scope 2..27 (median 4)
  depth 3: region_size 595..903 (median 686), in_scope 50..60 (median 55)

THE MODULE'S OWN ARGUMENT FOR 3 DOES NOT SURVIVE READING scope_region. scope.rs:76-80 justifies 3 as 'the smallest number that reaches a Component's whole thread: its capabilities are one hop away, the requirements they satisfy and the artifacts and checks that realize and verify them are two, and A CONTAINED CHILD COMPONENT'S CAPABILITIES ARE THREE'. But scope_region is containment_closure(seed) THEN propagate_from(owned, depth) — contained children are already IN `owned`, unboundedly, so their capabilities are ONE hop from an owned node, not three. The third hop buys only what the same doc calls 'the neighbours' neighbours, which is the program again'. By its own reasoning the default should be 2.

TWO DEFAULTS FOR ONE STATED COMPUTATION. detect_gaps' tool description says the region is 'the same computation claim_region uses for "the part I hold", so "my area" means one thing everywhere'. It is not the same on two counts: the MCP default depth is 3 for scope and 2 for claim_region, and scope_region adds the containment closure while claimed_region takes the radius alone — a divergence scope.rs:38-42 already records as possibly a defect in the claims layer and deliberately left unfixed.

NOT FIXED HERE. Changing DEFAULT_SCOPE_DEPTH changes what every existing scoped caller sees, and reconciling claim_region with scope_region changes what two people believe they hold. Both are put to the owner rather than taken.
